result.stdout:
tamp migrate nuke [--root <dir>] [--build-dir <dir>] [--dry-run] [--allow-dirty] [--package-major <N>] [--tamp-version <v>]

  Preview. Rewrites a NUKE build to Tamp in place: its C# files, its build project, and the
  tamp init bootstrap (tamp.sh, tamp.cmd, the dotnet-tamp tool entry). Auto-tier mappings are
  applied; every other recognised site gets a // TAMP-MIGRATE(<id>) marker. Writes
  tamp-migration.json and tamp-migration.md to the root.

  --root           repository root (default: current directory)
  --build-dir      the NUKE build project's directory, relative to the root (default: build)
  --dry-run        report only; change no files
  --allow-dirty    run even if the git working tree has uncommitted changes
  --package-major  major for versioned wrappers, e.g. 8 for Tamp.NetCli.V8 (default: newest)
  --tamp-version   version for the Tamp package references (default: this tool's version)
